name: Lagos
jurisdiction: Lagos State, Nigeria (Lagos State Tenancy Law 2011)
summary: Common Lagos residential patterns, informed by the Lagos State Tenancy Law 2011. The Law does not apply in every area of Lagos; check its scope section for your location.

rules.title: Rent demanded in advance
rules.note: The Lagos State Tenancy Law 2011 restricts how much rent a landlord may demand or receive in advance, with different limits for new and sitting tenants (for example, more than one year in advance for a new yearly tenant is restricted). Large multi-year advance demands are worth challenging.
rules.ask: How many months or years of rent are you asking for up front, and can it be limited to what the Tenancy Law allows?
rules.source: Lagos State Tenancy Law 2011, s.4 (check the current text).

rules.title: Agency, legal, caution and service charges
rules.note: Agency, legal, caution (deposit) and service charges are common in Lagos and can add a large share to the first-year cost. Ask for each one in writing with what it covers and whether it is refundable.
rules.ask: Please list every one-time and recurring charge, what each covers, and which are refundable.
rules.source: Common Lagos market practice; check the Lagos State Tenancy Law 2011 and any current agency regulations.

rules.title: Fees large relative to rent
rules.note: When required fees add up to a large share of rent, the real cost of the tenancy is much higher than the quoted rent.
rules.ask: Can any of these charges be reduced or folded into the rent?

rules.title: Notice periods
rules.note: The Tenancy Law sets minimum statutory notice lengths that depend on the tenancy type (for example, longer notice for yearly tenancies than monthly ones). A lease term that cuts these short may not hold up.
rules.ask: Does the notice clause match the minimum notice in the Lagos State Tenancy Law for this type of tenancy?
rules.source: Lagos State Tenancy Law 2011, s.13 (check the current text).

rules.title: Caution deposit size
rules.note: A caution (security) deposit is common. Make sure the amount, refund conditions and timeline are written down.
rules.ask: When and how will the caution deposit be refunded, and what deductions are allowed?

rules.title: Renewal and rent review
rules.note: Clarify whether the tenancy renews, at what rent, and how much notice of a rent increase you will get.
rules.ask: How will renewal and any rent increase be handled, and how much notice will I get?

rules.title: Repairs pushed onto the tenant
rules.note: Make sure structural repairs and major installations remain the landlord's responsibility in writing.
rules.ask: Which repairs will you handle, and how quickly?
